rationale: The internal-share leg multiplied by the total-intangible-base leg economically collapses back to internal intangible intensity over assets, so the signal is close to a repackaging of the archived "Internal Intangibles over Goodwill Profit" and the gen-0/gen-1 profitability × intangible-intensity constructions rather than a substantively new mechanism.

Because COALESCE sets missing intan to zero, the "expensed gap" leg reduces to plain intangible spending intensity for most firms, making this a near-duplicate of the archived "Lagged Intangible Margin Inflection" with a sales rather than asset scaler, i.e., a leg-swap between two already-evaluated signals.

This is a cosmetic level-versus-change variant of the archived "Cash-Validated Intangible Turnover Improvement" (DELTA replaced by TS_RANK) crossed with the TS_RANK cash-margin leg already used in "Goodwill-Light Intangible Cash High," and the turnover leg is essentially the well-known asset-turnover profitability component.

Adding a sales-drawdown condition to the goodwill-plus-margin-decay short is an economically coherent impairment-prediction refinement with a correctly signed expression, though it inherits the archived version's weak Fama-MacBeth evidence without diagnosing the alpha/FMB disagreement and the COALESCE(gdwl,0) zero mass will leave a heavily tied, unstable short leg.

The R&D-stock-then-rising-advertising sequencing is a genuinely distinct commercialization mechanism not present in the archive and is internally consistent with a positive sign, but the xad trend leg is heavily zero-inflated by the COALESCE, so coverage and effective discrimination should be checked closely.

Replacing the (oibdp + intangibles) denominator with gross profit makes this a scaler-level variant of the archived "Profitable Intangible Reinvestment Share," and both legs individually are close to the well-documented gross-profitability and R&D-intensity anomalies.
